title: Togepi — Neo Genesis 1st Edition
caption:
Togepi — Neo Genesis 1st Edition
PSA 8 / Near Mint–Mint

I have examined this Togepi with the level of seriousness usually reserved for a suspicious bridge.

First edition Neo Genesis. PSA 8. Forty HP. One attack: Poison Barb. That's right. He sits in a tree looking like an egg somebody startled, and his plan is to poison you.

An 8 is a respectable grade for a card from 2000. Before anybody declares it ‘basically a 10,’ please remember that numbers are different numbers. I'm working on a chart to explain this to the community. My nephew says charts don't do well on social media, but my nephew has never evaluated a Togepi.

The front looks clean in this photo, though a slab picture alone won't tell us everything about the corners and back. That is why I remain professionally cautious and personally thrilled.

My official assessment: excellent little card. Also, if four proverbs say a sleeping Togepi brings happiness, I believe we are legally required to let him nap.

title: Dark Blastoise — Team Rocket
caption:
Dark Blastoise — Team Rocket
PSA 5 / Excellent

I have placed this card before the committee. Team Rocket gave Blastoise a darker uniform, which I believe counts as a hostile corporate rebrand. This listed copy is PSA 5 / Excellent. The turtle looks capable of shutting down a marina by merely arriving at it. My official recommendation is to keep him away from the office water cooler.

title: Kyogre — EX Emerald
caption:
Kyogre — EX Emerald
PSA 10

Today’s case landed on my desk, which is also the kitchen table when the office is closed. This Kyogre appears to have brought an entire weather system to a card inspection. I cleared the desk of beverages as a professional courtesy to the ocean. The forecast from the unofficial grading department is extremely damp and cautiously optimistic.

title: Snorlax — Japanese Zukan
caption:
Snorlax — Japanese Zukan
PSA 6

Before anyone asks, I am treating this like a real inspection. A PSA 6 Snorlax is still more organized than I am before noon. The card shows the sort of commitment to resting that I once reserved for researching auction results. Please do not disturb him until my investigation of his snack budget is complete.

title: Gengar — Chinese CBB3
caption:
Gengar — Chinese CBB3
PSA 10

This is the sort of assignment that makes me straighten my shirt before sitting alone at home. Gengar looks delighted to have found a new language in which to make everyone uncomfortable. A perfect grade is appropriate for a ghost who apparently remembered to file all the paperwork. The unofficial haunting report reads: excellent presentation, suspicious smile.

title: Muk — Japanese Fossil
caption:
Muk — Japanese Fossil
PSA 9

I called an emergency meeting of the grading committee. I put on gloves to examine a photograph of Muk, which my family called unnecessary. Japanese Fossil Muk somehow turns a purple puddle into a respectable vintage collectible. My desk remains clean; my sense of smell has filed a complaint anyway.

title: Yveltal — Shining Fates
caption:
Yveltal — Shining Fates
PSA 9

I blocked off fifteen minutes for this card and then spent twelve of them making the title look official. Yveltal arrives looking like the final boss of a meeting that should have been an email. A PSA 9 is strong, though I suspect the giant red wings requested an appeal. I have declined to schedule a one-on-one with the bird.

title: Pikachu VMAX — Vivid Voltage
caption:
Pikachu VMAX — Vivid Voltage
PSA 9

I opened a fresh page in the grading ledger and used my good pen. This Pikachu has expanded beyond the dimensions normally approved by the electrical department. I measured the photo with a ruler before remembering that is not how card dimensions work. Power rating: large enough to require its own ZIP code.

title: Arceus — Movie Commemoration
caption:
Arceus — Movie Commemoration
PSA 7

I put on my serious face for this one. Arceus looks like it is attending a premiere that it may also have created. A movie commemorative card deserves a red carpet, so I used a red dish towel. The creator of the universe has politely declined my offer to inspect the corners.

title: Munchlax — Domino’s Pizza promo
caption:
Munchlax — Domino’s Pizza promo
PSA 8

I wrote IMPORTANT on a folder, then remembered the entire case is an eBay listing photo. A Domino's Munchlax promo is the first card I have reviewed while genuinely considering dinner. Munchlax understands the importance of promotional partnerships and probably ate the meeting agenda. My valuation spreadsheet now has a column labeled extra cheese.

title: Pikachu — Hidden Fates
caption:
Pikachu — Hidden Fates
PSA 9

I would like to begin by assuring everyone that my conclusions have been peer reviewed by nobody. This Pikachu is enjoying Hidden Fates while I search for the receipt from my last card purchase. A PSA 9 suggests excellent presentation and one small mystery that I refuse to solve from a photo. The detective remains on the case, mainly because I own a magnifying glass.

title: Magikarp — Expedition
caption:
Magikarp — Expedition
PSA 9

This specimen has been assigned a case number and a very small amount of undeserved ceremony. A PSA 9 Expedition Magikarp proves persistence and excellent archival practices are separate talents. The non-holo fish is working very hard to appear unaware of its own collectible status. I have entered its splash as a formal statement of intent.

title: Blastoise EX — XY full art
caption:
Blastoise EX — XY full art
PSA 7 / Near Mint

The card has my full attention. Blastoise EX fills the whole frame like he paid for the premium photo package. The full art gives me less empty space to pretend I am analyzing and more turtle to admire. I am calling this a high-pressure water feature with a card attached.

title: Venusaur — Trading Card Game Classic
caption:
Venusaur — Trading Card Game Classic
PSA 10

My inspection station is fully operational, except the printer and several of my assumptions. This Venusaur has a PSA 10 and the calm expression of someone who already owns the greenhouse. Classic presentation makes even my filing cabinet feel underqualified. My official plant care advice is to keep the slab out of direct sunlight.

title: Doduo — Japanese Basic
caption:
Doduo — Japanese Basic
PSA 9

The card arrived on my screen and I immediately adjusted the desk lamp, although the photo was already taken. Two heads, one PSA label, and I still had to check the number twice. I attempted separate interviews with both Doduo heads; neither confirmed who was in charge. The investigation is ongoing, but both suspects remain in excellent vintage company.

title: Ancient Mew — movie promo
caption:
Ancient Mew — movie promo
PSA 9

I have brought the loupe, a notebook, and a level of confidence my qualifications have not requested. Ancient Mew looks like an artifact that should come with a museum guard and a decoding ring. I held the slab upside down for three minutes before deciding the language was not the problem. The historical society has not returned my calls, which I interpret as respect.

title: Solgaleo — Celebrations
caption:
Solgaleo — Celebrations
PSA 8

I have been preparing for this review since I learned to say near mint in a stern voice. Solgaleo brought a lion's worth of confidence to a set literally named Celebrations. A PSA 8 is respectable, although the artwork seems to think it deserves a parade. I am willing to approve a small parade with prior notice.

title: Mew — Celebrations
caption:
Mew — Celebrations
PSA 9

I have reviewed the photographic evidence with the confidence of a man who owns two rulers. Mew appears to be floating through a party while everyone else handles setup and cleanup. The little holo has the face of someone who knows where the cake is hidden. My assessment is that this is an excellent guest and a terrible volunteer.

title: Moltres, Zapdos & Articuno GX — Hidden Fates
caption:
Moltres, Zapdos & Articuno GX — Hidden Fates
PSA 9

Today I am acting as lead researcher, which is easier when no one else works here. Three legendary birds on one card is an efficiency measure I can support. I tried assigning each bird a separate line in my inspection log and ran out of authority. This is a committee meeting I would attend, provided nobody brings a fourth bird.

title: Ho-Oh — Celebrations
caption:
Ho-Oh — Celebrations
PSA 9

I have opened a formal inquiry into this card, despite there being no formal department and very little inquiry. Ho-Oh has arrived for the anniversary dressed like the entire fireworks budget. A PSA 9 is a strong result for a bird with absolutely no interest in subtlety. I hereby approve the use of the good display stand.

title: Charmander — First Partner promo
caption:
Charmander — First Partner promo
PSA 9

Our unofficial department is pleased to present its findings. Charmander has been chosen as a First Partner and is already behaving like the camera crew follows him. The little flame makes me nervous around my paper grading forms. My fire safety plan is to admire this one from a respectful distance.

title: Thwackey — Shining Fates
caption:
Thwackey — Shining Fates
PSA 10

Thwackey earned a PSA 10 while holding what appear to be drumsticks and a schedule of disruptions. I have had quieter inspections beside active construction sites. The percussion department has passed its exam with honors.

title: Articuno — Fossil holo
caption:
Articuno — Fossil holo
PSA 8

Fossil Articuno looks like it froze the air around my desk on purpose. The old holo catches light in a way that makes me forget what I was going to say about centering. My report has been delayed by an unauthorized moment of wonder.

title: Arcanine — XY Evolutions
caption:
Arcanine — XY Evolutions
PSA 8 / Near Mint–Mint

Arcanine runs into the frame like it heard someone open a bag of treats three counties away. A PSA 8 is serious collector territory, even if I keep calling it a very good dog. My assistant has reminded me the grading label does not include obedience scores.

title: Rocket’s Orbeetle — Japanese SV10
caption:
Rocket’s Orbeetle — Japanese SV10
PSA 8

Rocket's Orbeetle looks like a science project that gained access to the budget committee. An art rare deserves a careful look, and perhaps a firm lid on the specimen jar. I am not accusing it of reading my thoughts, but I changed the password.

title: Alakazam — Base Set holo
caption:
Alakazam — Base Set holo
PSA 9

Base Set Alakazam holds two spoons and the sort of vintage authority I wish my business cards conveyed. I asked it for a prediction about future prices; it bent the office cutlery instead. That is not financial guidance, but it was memorable.

title: Heracross — Japanese Neo
caption:
Heracross — Japanese Neo
PSA 8 / Near Mint–Mint

Heracross has a horn that looks better equipped for negotiations than I am. Japanese Neo gives this beetle the kind of vintage résumé that gets a second interview. I have promoted it to acting head of the branch office.

title: Articuno — Aoki error promo
caption:
Articuno — Aoki error promo
PSA 10

An Aoki error Articuno means the error is part of the conversation, not a defect I invented. I wrote ERROR in my notebook so large that a neighbor asked if I was safe. The bird is fine; the paperwork has become theatrical.

title: Pikachu — SWSH020 promo
caption:
Pikachu — SWSH020 promo
PSA 9

Promo Pikachu has the confidence of somebody who has never lost a charging cable. The little holo gets a proper inspection even though it keeps distracting me with its face. My findings are filed under bright, cheerful, and mildly conductive.

title: Vaporeon ex — Japanese 2006
caption:
Vaporeon ex — Japanese 2006
PSA 9 / Mint

Vaporeon ex looks like it reserved the entire pool for a private appointment. A vintage Japanese ex card makes me speak more formally than my coworkers prefer. The water bill for this inspection will be forwarded to the collector.

title: Zoroark — 2025 holo
caption:
Zoroark — 2025 holo
PSA 10 / Gem Mint

Zoroark is a master of illusion, so I double-checked the PSA label before trusting my own eyes. This listed copy is PSA 10 / Gem Mint. The dark artwork suggests the card knows something about me and intends to keep it private. My report remains confident, subject to the room being real.

title: Loudred — illustration rare
caption:
Loudred — illustration rare
PSA 8

Loudred has made an illustration rare for anyone who felt card collecting was too quiet. I recorded a note in the inspection log and immediately imagined it yelling the note back. Volume control is not listed as a grading subcategory, unfortunately.

title: Machop — 1999 Topps TV
caption:
Machop — 1999 Topps TV
PSA 6 / Excellent–Mint

This is a Topps TV card, and Machop appears prepared to lift the whole grading desk. A television-era collectible follows different numbering from the TCG, which I explained to a lamp. The lamp seemed impressed; I have not told my family.

title: Mew — Secret Wonders holo bleed
caption:
Mew — Secret Wonders holo bleed
PSA 7

The listing calls this holo bleed, which makes the shine a topic of investigation rather than a medical emergency. Mew is floating through the evidence like it knows my conclusions before I do. The sparkle has been entered into the record with excessive enthusiasm.

title: Pikachu — Build-A-Bear promo
caption:
Pikachu — Build-A-Bear promo
PSA 10

Build-A-Bear Pikachu is proof that a store can sell a stuffed friend and still hand me homework. The promo has the cheerful confidence of someone with a wardrobe of tiny accessories. I briefly considered making the slab a little sweater.

title: Electrode — Japanese Jungle
caption:
Electrode — Japanese Jungle
PSA 9

Electrode is smiling like it has already located the emergency power switch. A Japanese Jungle holo deserves respect, but I refuse to inspect it beside loose batteries. The electrical inspection is complete and the desk is still here.

title: Jynx — Base Set
caption:
Jynx — Base Set
PSA 9 / Mint

Jynx from the original era arrived with all the confidence of a performer halfway through a solo. The vintage label gives me a reason to take notes, though not to pretend I saw the back. My stage review is favorable; the encore requires a second photo.

title: Victini — Scarlet & Violet promo
caption:
Victini — Scarlet & Violet promo
PSA 8

Victini is the victory Pokémon, which seems like an unfair advantage in a grading appointment. I informed the card that victory must be supported by evidence; it continued smiling. My unofficial ruling: the optimism is contagious, the grade remains the grade.

title: Bonnie — Forbidden Light full art
caption:
Bonnie — Forbidden Light full art
PSA 10

Bonnie has a PSA 10 and looks more composed than the person conducting this evaluation. Full-art trainer cards deserve the same scrutiny as monsters with claws and weather systems. I have placed her in charge of the meeting; nobody objected.

title: Houndoom EX — BREAKthrough
caption:
Houndoom EX — BREAKthrough
PSA 8

Houndoom EX appears to have read the office policy and chosen fire anyway. A PSA 8 is a respectable result for a card whose subject looks ready to terminate my probation. I am keeping the exit clear as a grading best practice.

title: Mew ex — Scarlet & Violet 151
caption:
Mew ex — Scarlet & Violet 151
PSA 9

The 151 Mew ex is pink, powerful, and completely uninterested in my organizational system. Its full-art presence makes a small slab feel like a large event. I have scheduled a follow-up with my own sense of wonder.

title: Electabuzz — movie promo
caption:
Electabuzz — movie promo
PSA 9

Movie promo Electabuzz looks like it got cast in a film and immediately asked for better lighting. A PSA 9 suits a card with that much electricity and promotional confidence. No autographs were obtained; I did not want to start a scene.

title: Raichu — Fossil non-holo
caption:
Raichu — Fossil non-holo
PSA 7 / Near Mint

Fossil Raichu proves a card can be charming without the holo spotlight. I appreciate a Pokémon that evolved and still did not demand a red carpet. The non-holo department has asked me to stop calling it the supporting cast.

title: Suicune ex — Classic Collection
caption:
Suicune ex — Classic Collection
PSA 10

Suicune ex moves through this Classic Collection card like an unusually elegant water inspection. The PSA 10 label is crisp, but I still caught myself checking my reflection in the slab. My report says gem mint; my hair says another matter.

title: Cloyster — Topsun green back
caption:
Cloyster — Topsun green back
PSA 4

A green-back Topsun Cloyster is exactly the sort of specific vintage object that ruins my evening plans. PSA 4 has lived a little, which is more honest than my claim that I only looked briefly. The shell is closed; my research tabs are multiplying.

title: Dragonite — Fossil non-holo
caption:
Dragonite — Fossil non-holo
PSA 1

Please remain calm. This Dragonite has received a PSA 1, and I would like everyone to know I am handling the news with professionalism.

You can see substantial wear on the front, especially around the borders and lower half. I'd want to see the back before pretending I know every reason for the grade. Unlike certain people on the internet, I do not grade the side of a card I cannot see. I grade it emotionally, which is a separate service.

This is the non-holo #19 from Fossil, not the holo #4. Its Pokémon Power, Step In, lets Dragonite move from the Bench into the Active Spot. Honestly, after what this card has been through, I would let it stay on the Bench and bring it a chair.

A PSA 1 is still a real, authenticated grade. The card survived, got dressed in a slab, and showed up for inspection. Frankly, that's a stronger Monday than I usually manage.

Professor's ruling: rough condition, outstanding attitude.

title: Gyarados — Base Set shadowless
caption:
Gyarados — Base Set shadowless
PSA 1 / Poor

Shadowless Base Set Gyarados is the kind of phrase that makes collectors sit up straight. This listed copy is PSA 1 / Poor. I brought a calm voice to the inspection because the fish clearly did not. My desk is dry, but the atmosphere remains hostile.

title: Mewtwo ex — Japanese Red Flash
caption:
Mewtwo ex — Japanese Red Flash
PSA 9

First-edition Mewtwo ex has a PSA 9 and the demeanor of a laboratory director disappointed in my methodology. I asked it to review my notes; the silence felt like peer review. The experiment continues under unusually intense supervision.

title: Gyarados — Korean Bandit Ring
caption:
Gyarados — Korean Bandit Ring
PSA 10

Korean Bandit Ring Gyarados earned a PSA 10 while looking ready to overturn the boat. The language and set deserve to be identified precisely; guessing a market from memory is not a method. I have filed it under beautiful, loud, and seaworthy only in theory.

title: Articuno — Fossil holo PSA 7
caption:
Articuno — Fossil holo PSA 7
PSA 7

Another Fossil Articuno arrived, this time with a PSA 7 and a separate life story. The icy bird still has more poise than I do when somebody asks for a quick valuation. I decline to rank its personality against other Articuno specimens.

title: Donphan — staff prerelease promo
caption:
Donphan — staff prerelease promo
PSA 10

A STAFF prerelease Donphan is a tiny badge of authority carried by a very large rolling elephant. I have never received a staff card, despite arriving early to several events. The personnel department has been informed of this injustice.

title: Houndour — illustration rare
caption:
Houndour — illustration rare
PSA 8

Houndour on an illustration rare looks like a puppy with a mysterious side quest. A PSA 8 means the slab has a grade; it does not tell me whether the dog is housebroken. The adoption interview is going well so far.

title: Pikachu — Trading Card Game Classic
caption:
Pikachu — Trading Card Game Classic
PSA 10

Classic Collection Pikachu is doing a remarkably good job of being Pikachu in a formal setting. A PSA 10 gives the little yellow celebrity another reason to avoid my calls. I will keep the interview brief and leave a snack.

title: Slowbro EX — XY Evolutions
caption:
Slowbro EX — XY Evolutions
PSA 9

Slowbro EX looks like it has forgotten why it entered the room, which is how I conduct half my inspections. The PSA 9 label is much clearer about its purpose than I am. I recommend patience, a sturdy shelf, and perhaps a calendar reminder.

title: Articuno — Japanese Classic Collection
caption:
Articuno — Japanese Classic Collection
PSA 10

The Japanese Classic Collection gave Articuno a very proper stage and a PSA 10. I considered wearing a tie to write this review; the bird already looked overdressed for me. The cold front has excellent credentials.

title: Budew — illustration rare
caption:
Budew — illustration rare
PSA 10

Budew has earned a PSA 10 while looking small enough to fit inside my coffee mug. That is not a proposed storage solution; my legal department is a houseplant and disapproves. The tiny floral committee has approved this submission.

title: Kingdra — Neo Genesis holo
caption:
Kingdra — Neo Genesis holo
PSA 6

A PSA 6 Neo Genesis Kingdra has the kind of vintage history you cannot reproduce by printing the year on a sticker. I refuse to confuse wear with a lack of dignity. The sea horse has earned a proper place in the archive.

title: Eevee — Jungle
caption:
Eevee — Jungle
PSA 8

Jungle Eevee is the rare card that can make a grown collector say aww and then immediately check centering. A PSA 8 vintage copy has clearly been taken more seriously than my childhood chores. I would like to adopt the card and its filing habits.

title: Radiant Eternatus — Japanese
caption:
Radiant Eternatus — Japanese
PSA 10

Radiant Eternatus looks as if somebody opened a portal directly into my spreadsheet. A PSA 10 is a neat label for a creature that refuses to fit inside neat categories. I have closed the portal and backed up the spreadsheet.

title: Pikachu — Celebrations full art
caption:
Pikachu — Celebrations full art
PSA 6 / Excellent–Mint

Celebrations Pikachu fills the card with the confidence of a guest who brought the cake and ate the first slice. The full-art layout makes even my inspection lamp seem festive. This is officially a work event, according to nobody but me.

title: Articuno, Zapdos & Moltres — Carddass
caption:
Articuno, Zapdos & Moltres — Carddass
Three PSA grades: Articuno 4, Zapdos 6, Moltres 7

These 1997 Carddass bird cards are shown together, so I am reviewing the photograph as a small flock. This listed copy is Three PSA grades: Articuno 4, Zapdos 6, Moltres 7. Three separate slabs mean three separate identities, despite my desire to finish before dinner. The committee has voted unanimously to remain legendary.

title: Pikachu — miscut SWSH198 promo
caption:
Pikachu — miscut SWSH198 promo
PSA 9(MC) / Mint, miscut designation

A PSA 9MC Pikachu is the perfect reminder that a miscut can be the headline rather than a mistake to hide. This listed copy is PSA 9(MC) / Mint, miscut designation. The cut has wandered off course, and the card seems delighted with itself. My ruler has requested time off after this one.

title: Wigglytuff — illustration rare
caption:
Wigglytuff — illustration rare
PSA 10

Wigglytuff looks sweet enough to sell baked goods and confident enough to own the bakery. A PSA 10 art rare gets a formal review, even if I spent most of it smiling. The bakery metaphor is not part of the population report.

title: Galarian Moltres — Japanese
caption:
Galarian Moltres — Japanese
PSA 10

Galarian Moltres has the energy of a bird that resigned from the fire department and became the fire. The Japanese PSA 10 slab looks composed; the artwork does not share that restraint. I have moved the office extinguisher closer for morale.

title: Venusaur — 1999 Topps TV
caption:
Venusaur — 1999 Topps TV
PSA 1

A PSA 1 Topps Venusaur is a wonderful survivor from a different branch of Pokémon card history. This listed copy is PSA 1. This is a television card, so I will not pretend its number belongs in a TCG set checklist. The plant has seen things, and I would listen to its stories.

title: Dark Arbok — Team Rocket holo
caption:
Dark Arbok — Team Rocket holo
PSA 5

Dark Arbok has a PSA 5 and the attitude of a snake who read the employee handbook for loopholes. This listed copy is PSA 5. The Team Rocket holo still has plenty of character without pretending to be untouched. I am keeping one eye on my pen.

title: Gyarados — Pokémon Rumble
caption:
Gyarados — Pokémon Rumble
PSA 7

A Pokémon Rumble Gyarados looks like a cartoon wave decided to take a management course. The PSA 7 grade gives the card a real condition category, not a punchline. The fish, however, has provided several punchlines without consent.

title: Magmar — Base Set
caption:
Magmar — Base Set
PSA 9

Base Set Magmar looks warm enough to make my desk lamp redundant. A PSA 9 from the original era is worth discussing carefully without inventing prices from the ceiling. My ceiling thanks me, and the fire marshal would too.

title: Machoke — Scarlet & Violet 151
caption:
Machoke — Scarlet & Violet 151
PSA 8

Machoke is doing manual labor in the 151 art while I take notes from a chair. An illustration rare that makes everyday work look heroic deserves a longer look. I offered to help move the furniture; the card declined.

title: Houndoom — Japanese art rare
caption:
Houndoom — Japanese art rare
PSA 10

Houndoom in this art rare looks like the night shift has finally found its supervisor. A PSA 10 keeps the grading discussion tidy, unlike whatever is happening in that ominous scene. My flashlight has been promoted to senior associate.

title: Dark Hypno — Team Rocket 1st Edition
caption:
Dark Hypno — Team Rocket 1st Edition
PSA 8

First-edition Dark Hypno has the precise look of somebody who already knows my password. A PSA 8 is respectable, but I will not make eye contact with the pendulum for long. The meeting ended when I realized I was nodding.

title: Pidgey — Japanese art rare
caption:
Pidgey — Japanese art rare
PSA 10

Pidgey got an art rare and immediately started acting like a documentary crew followed it. The PSA 10 does not change the fact that this bird could steal my sandwich. I have placed my lunch under supervised storage.

title: Pikachu — The Best of XY
caption:
Pikachu — The Best of XY
PSA 8

The Best of XY Pikachu looks ready to give me a tour of its favorite era. A PSA 8 Japanese print deserves identification beyond the species and a casual thumbs-up. I have prepared a little name badge for the appointment.

title: Lugia — 151/S-P promo
caption:
Lugia — 151/S-P promo
PSA 10

Lugia has PSA 10 credentials and the posture of a creature that owns the entire coastline. I moved my coffee before the inspection because the artwork made the desk feel stormy. The tide report is excellent; my paperwork is waterlogged in spirit.

title: Umbreon — Yu Nagaba promo
caption:
Umbreon — Yu Nagaba promo
PSA 10

Yu Nagaba Umbreon looks like a very confident sketch that escaped a notebook. Minimal lines can carry an enormous amount of personality, which my seventeen-page grading memo cannot. I am reducing the memo to sixteen pages in its honor.

title: Espeon & Deoxys GX — SM240
caption:
Espeon & Deoxys GX — SM240
PSA 8

Espeon and Deoxys GX share a card but appear to have very different ideas about a team-building exercise. The PSA 8 slab contains both personalities without taking sides. I have assigned myself the role of neutral facilitator and will sit far away.

title: Tyranitar GX — Lost Thunder
caption:
Tyranitar GX — Lost Thunder
PSA 7

Tyranitar GX looks like it could demolish the inspection table and then ask for a more stable one. A PSA 7 is a grade, not a measure of how much furniture the Pokémon can lift. I am reviewing this from a structurally sound distance.

title: M Rayquaza EX — 25th Anniversary promo
caption:
M Rayquaza EX — 25th Anniversary promo
PSA 10

M Rayquaza EX winds across this anniversary card like it refuses to fit in the margins. The PSA 10 label is tidy; the dragon's scheduling habits appear less so. I have reserved the entire sky for its follow-up appointment.

title: Gardevoir — World Champs Pack
caption:
Gardevoir — World Champs Pack
PSA 10

A 2007 Japanese World Champs Pack Gardevoir makes me feel as though I should have prepared a speech. The PSA 10 says the card arrived ready; my speech remains on an index card. The ceremony will proceed without a podium.

title: Mega Lucario ex — Mega Evolution
caption:
Mega Lucario ex — Mega Evolution
PSA 9

Mega Lucario ex looks like the assistant manager of a dojo who actually runs the place. A PSA 9 is strong, and I will not request a sparring demonstration to settle anything. My grading loupe is not protective equipment.

title: Lapras — Japanese Family Card Game
caption:
Lapras — Japanese Family Card Game
PSA 10

Lapras looks like it would give everyone a safe ride across the lake and then remember their names. A PSA 10 on a family game card makes the trip feel unusually formal. I have packed snacks for the imaginary crossing.

title: Ninetales — Legendary Collection
caption:
Ninetales — Legendary Collection
PSA 9

Legendary Collection Ninetales brings nine tails and more holographic ambition than my entire desk setup. A PSA 9 is impressive, though I refuse to count each tail as a separate condition category. The fox has declined my proposed spreadsheet.

title: Psyduck — Japanese 151 art rare
caption:
Psyduck — Japanese 151 art rare
PSA 10

Psyduck looks like it has been asked a simple question and can now hear its own heartbeat. The PSA 10 slab protects the card but cannot help with that headache. I have prescribed a quiet room and no follow-up questions.

title: Ditto as Squirtle — Japanese PCG
caption:
Ditto as Squirtle — Japanese PCG
PSA 9

This Ditto is impersonating Squirtle, so the first order of business is confirming who attended the appointment. The PSA 9 label knows; I merely needed a minute. I have updated the visitor log under both names.

title: M Ampharos EX — Ancient Origins
caption:
M Ampharos EX — Ancient Origins
PSA 8

M Ampharos EX has enough electricity to make my extension cord feel personally inadequate. A PSA 8 gives me a reason to be precise while the artwork tries to blind the committee. The power company has been notified in my imagination.

title: Flygon — Phantasmal Flames staff promo
caption:
Flygon — Phantasmal Flames staff promo
PSA 10

A STAFF prerelease Flygon is a card with credentials and wings, a dangerous combination at a convention. The PSA 10 means the slab showed up prepared for work. I have asked it to cover my shift and received no reply.

title: Celebi — Skyridge Crystal
caption:
Celebi — Skyridge Crystal
PSA 9

Skyridge Crystal Celebi is the sort of card that makes me lower my voice in my own apartment. A PSA 9 and a 2003 secret-rare designation deserve careful reading, not a wild price guess. The time traveler has requested the original receipt.

title: Jolteon ex — Japanese SV8a
caption:
Jolteon ex — Japanese SV8a
PSA 10

Jolteon ex has a PSA 10 and enough visual voltage to restart my ancient printer. I briefly considered testing that theory, but my printer is a valued historical artifact. The lightning department approves this one.

title: Glaceon VSTAR — Japanese SAR
caption:
Glaceon VSTAR — Japanese SAR
PSA 10

Glaceon VSTAR looks like winter agreed to pose politely for a portrait. A PSA 10 label offers clinical certainty; the art makes me want hot cocoa and a window seat. The seasonal inspection has been approved.

title: Leafeon LV.X — Majestic Dawn
caption:
Leafeon LV.X — Majestic Dawn
PSA 7

Leafeon LV.X from Majestic Dawn has the aura of a houseplant that completed graduate school. A PSA 7 vintage-era card can still command a room without pretending to be flawless. I am watering my notes, which was a mistake.

title: Greninja BREAK — Japanese
caption:
Greninja BREAK — Japanese
PSA 10

Greninja BREAK looks as if the card itself is moving too quickly for my desk procedures. A PSA 10 is decisive; I am still trying to locate the ninja in the artwork. The case file is marked stealthy but cooperative.

title: Mimikyu V — Japanese
caption:
Mimikyu V — Japanese
PSA 10

Mimikyu V has a costume and a PSA 10, so I believe it has prepared more thoroughly than I have. I will not ask what is under the disguise because I enjoy sleeping. The identity remains confidential under department policy.

title: Garchomp V — Battle Region
caption:
Garchomp V — Battle Region
PSA 10

Garchomp V arrived looking like it ate the previous inspection form. A PSA 10 suggests the actual card was treated with much more care than my paperwork. I have moved the stapler out of reach.

title: Piplup — Inferno X art rare
caption:
Piplup — Inferno X art rare
PSA 8

Piplup is tiny, adorable, and somehow has a PSA 8 appraisal meeting on my calendar. The art rare treatment gives this penguin a more elaborate setting than my last vacation. I am officially rooting for the applicant.

title: Bulbasaur — Japanese 151 art rare
caption:
Bulbasaur — Japanese 151 art rare
PSA 10

Bulbasaur looks like it has been gardening since before I learned what a sleeve was. A PSA 10 art rare presents the little plant with the dignity of a master landscaper. I have asked it for advice about my basil.

title: Squirtle — My First Battle
caption:
Squirtle — My First Battle
PSA 10

My First Battle Squirtle has a PSA 10 and appears ready to explain the rules to me patiently. That is good because I once lost a practice game to a child who read the instructions. The training department is in capable flippers.

title: Charmander — 1997 Carddass
caption:
Charmander — 1997 Carddass
PSA 4

A 1997 Carddass Charmander is a different kind of vintage collectible than a regular TCG print. The PSA 4 means it has been around; the little flame still looks eager for the next chapter. I have logged it under experienced but combustible.

title: Wartortle — Japanese 151 art rare
caption:
Wartortle — Japanese 151 art rare
PSA 9

Wartortle has graduated from beginner turtle to a PSA 9 art-rare professional. I admire the composure, especially while I search for my notes under the keyboard. The promotion paperwork is complete.

title: Raikou Gold Star — Unseen Forces
caption:
Raikou Gold Star — Unseen Forces
PSA 9

A Gold Star Raikou makes my voice turn into an auctioneer even when nobody is buying. The PSA 9 and 2005 Unseen Forces label are enough facts to discuss without making up a price. The thunder has been entered into the record.

title: Flareon — Yu Nagaba promo
caption:
Flareon — Yu Nagaba promo
PSA 10

Yu Nagaba Flareon is drawn with so few lines that my entire grading checklist feels overdressed. The PSA 10 slab gives the sketch a very formal frame. I will try to make my next report shorter; no promises.

title: Charmeleon
caption:
Charmeleon
PSA 10

My assistant is unavailable, primarily because I have never hired one. Charmeleon looks like an intern who discovered the thermostat controls the entire building. The flame is bigger now, and so is the confidence of whoever approved the promotion. I have filed a request for a fireproof clipboard.

title: Ivysaur
caption:
Ivysaur
PSA 10

The institute is proud to announce a new review. Ivysaur is halfway between a starter and a landscaping company with aggressive growth targets. The bud is doing more preparation than most people I have worked with. The greenhouse has placed it on the management track.

title: Meganium
caption:
Meganium
PSA 9

I said I would take a quick look. Meganium looks like it could calm a room full of collectors arguing about centering. I considered bringing it to my next family gathering but cannot afford the appearance fee. My ruling is peaceful, botanical, and unusually polite.

title: Typhlosion
caption:
Typhlosion
PSA 9

I have reserved the conference room for this card. Typhlosion arrives with the kind of collar that says the fire alarm is a suggestion. I would like to ask about the flames, but I also enjoy having eyebrows. The inspection ended at a safe distance.

title: Feraligatr
caption:
Feraligatr
PSA 10

I have prepared three questions for this card and somehow already filled a page with observations. Feraligatr has teeth, a long résumé, and no visible interest in my tiny grading mat. The water-type designation feels like an understatement when the mouth occupies most of the meeting. I am scheduling the follow-up behind a sturdy door.

title: Chikorita
caption:
Chikorita
PSA 9

The department is operating at full capacity, which means I remembered to charge my phone. Chikorita looks cheerful enough to host a children's show and determined enough to run the network. The leaf on its head is not a grading tool, despite my request. The botanical department remains cautiously charmed.

title: Cyndaquil
caption:
Cyndaquil
PSA 10

The grading committee has convened again. Cyndaquil has the expression of somebody who was awakened by a loud spreadsheet. Its flames make an excellent point about respecting personal space. I have revised the department's wake-up policy.

title: Totodile
caption:
Totodile
PSA 7

Let the record show that I came to this review calm, focused, and only slightly overprepared. Totodile is grinning like the inspection is a pool party it intends to turn into a wrestling match. The little crocodile has more enthusiasm than my entire Monday calendar. The swimming portion of this review is canceled.

title: Croconaw
caption:
Croconaw
PSA 10

An important specimen has entered the record. Croconaw looks like Totodile got a bigger jaw and a small business loan. It has not submitted a business plan, but the teeth appear ready to sign. I will keep the paperwork on my side of the table.

title: Bayleef
caption:
Bayleef
PSA 8

I placed this one on the agenda between market research and looking for my reading glasses. Bayleef has the calm authority of someone who can organize a greenhouse without raising its voice. I asked for plant care advice and received a silent performance review. My basil is still under observation.

title: Quilava
caption:
Quilava
PSA 9

The unofficial grading department has opened another case, and I have once again appointed myself chair. Quilava seems to move through the frame faster than the flames can keep up. The back fire makes me question whether my desk chair is rated for this assignment. I have declined the speed trial.

title: Pichu
caption:
Pichu
PSA 9

I approached this listing with the composure of a professional and the excitement of a man who found his missing loupe. Pichu is tiny, adorable, and somehow still a workplace electrical hazard. I checked the outlet covers before remembering this is a photo of a card. The safety report is mostly hearts and one lightning bolt.

title: Cleffa
caption:
Cleffa
PSA 10

This photograph demands careful consideration, which is my preferred excuse for ignoring the laundry. Cleffa looks like it wandered into a grading appointment on the way to a bedtime story. I lowered my voice to avoid disturbing its very serious star-shaped agenda. The committee has approved an early dismissal.

title: Igglybuff
caption:
Igglybuff
PSA 10

I had planned a quiet evening until this card made an extremely persuasive appearance on my screen. Igglybuff appears to be made of optimism and a quantity of fluff I cannot measure. A ruler would be an inappropriate instrument for this particular investigation. My official finding is approximately one hug.

title: Togetic
caption:
Togetic
PSA 8

The case file is open. Togetic has the posture of a good-news messenger who arrived before I finished the bad-news draft. The wings seem entirely too small for the amount of cheer being transported. The mood of the office has improved against policy.

title: Togekiss
caption:
Togekiss
PSA 10

I am submitting a preliminary report before the internet appoints twelve other experts to the case. Togekiss looks like it could deliver peace to a comment section, which would be an historic event. I have asked it to mediate my latest disagreement about binder organization. The mediation is pending; the bird is smiling anyway.

title: Azumarill
caption:
Azumarill
PSA 10

I have arranged the desk, adjusted the lamp, and asked the household to respect the seriousness of this appointment. Azumarill looks prepared to bounce into the meeting and ask why everyone is so tense. The ears are a logistical issue for my photo crop, not a condition issue. The water-balloon department is now open.

title: Marill
caption:
Marill
PSA 9

I sat down for a formal review and immediately knocked over the pencil cup. Marill has the face of a plush toy and the tail of a tiny navigation system. I would like to know where it is going, but it seems to have a better plan than I do. The route has been approved without a map.

title: Paldean Wooper
caption:
Paldean Wooper
PSA 10

I opened the listing and immediately sat up straighter. Wooper is smiling with no arms and more confidence than my entire staff, which is me. I attempted a handshake and was reminded that the photo cannot participate. The meeting was still a success.

title: Quagsire
caption:
Quagsire
PSA 9

Today’s investigation began with a listing photo and escalated into a full committee hearing with one attendee. Quagsire looks blissfully unaware of the considerable administrative work involved in being this charming. I envy its ability to stand in water and treat everything as fine. The stress department has been dissolved.

title: Politoed
caption:
Politoed
PSA 10

Politoed seems to be conducting an invisible choir with the gravity of a municipal official. I would listen to the performance, provided it does not require audience participation. The pond has granted a standing ovation.

title: Slowking
caption:
Slowking
PSA 7

Slowking is wearing a crown and appears to have arrived with a fully reasoned opinion. I asked whether my grading notes were adequate; the silence felt expensive. The royal review has been adjourned.

title: Wobbuffet
caption:
Wobbuffet
PSA 10

Wobbuffet has one expression and it is somehow more persuasive than all my charts. The tail in the back looks like a witness who needs a separate interview. I am not sure who is actually in charge.

title: Shuckle
caption:
Shuckle
PSA 10

Shuckle stores things in its shell, which is more organized than my current collection system. I considered asking it to inventory the office, but the hourly rate would be unreasonable. The shell is now our filing cabinet role model.

title: Sneasel
caption:
Sneasel
PSA 9

Sneasel looks like it would steal my loupe and then improve the entire inspection process. Those claws have a suspicious level of precision. I have counted my equipment twice.

title: Weavile
caption:
Weavile
PSA 9

Weavile has the confidence of a burglar who also reads the fine print on insurance policies. I respect the preparation while keeping my notebook within reach. The audit found all pens present, for now.

title: Delibird
caption:
Delibird
PSA 9

Delibird came carrying a sack and immediately made me nervous about the contents. The delivery schedule appears seasonal, but my curiosity is year-round. I will sign for the package only after seeing the label.

title: Mantine
caption:
Mantine
PSA 10

Mantine glides through the picture with the effortless calm of somebody who has never missed a deadline. I have asked it to teach my inbox to swim. The lesson has not been scheduled.

title: Skarmory
caption:
Skarmory
PSA 9

Skarmory looks like a bird assembled by an aerospace company during a very intense lunch break. I am not touching the wings to test the metal, even if the manual says inspect edges. The runway is clear and my hands remain attached.

title: Hoothoot
caption:
Hoothoot
PSA 10

Hoothoot is staring at me like it knows what time I said I would finish this review. The owl's schedule appears more disciplined than mine. I have stopped looking at the clock.

title: Noctowl
caption:
Noctowl
PSA 1

Noctowl looks like it could grade cards at midnight without needing my desk lamp. This pictured example is labeled PSA 1. I asked for its expert opinion and got a stare that felt like a written warning. The night shift has been assigned to the bird.

title: Xatu
caption:
Xatu
PSA 10

Xatu looks into the future, which would make price research much easier if it returned my calls. I asked one question about the market and received a very patient silence. The forecast remains withheld pending a better question.

title: Natu
caption:
Natu
PSA 9

Natu is a very small bird with a very large sense that it understands the universe. I do not challenge that claim because my own paperwork is overdue. The spiritual department has requested a perch.

title: Hoppip
caption:
Hoppip
PSA 8

Hoppip looks like a light breeze could reschedule the entire appointment. I set a paperweight beside the photo, which did absolutely nothing useful. The airspace remains open.

title: Skiploom
caption:
Skiploom
PSA 9

Skiploom appears to have graduated from floating around to floating around professionally. Its flower suggests a promotion I have yet to receive. The new title is assistant regional breeze.

title: Jumpluff
caption:
Jumpluff
PSA 8

Jumpluff travels by the wind and therefore has a commute I cannot put into mileage reports. The fluff is charming but impossible to file alphabetically. I am issuing a travel allowance in imaginary currency.

title: Sunflora
caption:
Sunflora
PSA 10

Sunflora looks like it has been asked to smile for the staff directory and took the job seriously. The sunflower is having a better day than my office plant. My plant has requested a transfer.

title: Sunkern
caption:
Sunkern
PSA 10

Sunkern is a seed with the confidence of an entire garden center. I admire that level of ambition from something that fits in a teaspoon. The growth forecast is emotionally encouraging.

title: Aipom
caption:
Aipom
PSA 10

Aipom has an extra hand on its tail and still looks capable of misplacing its keys. I cannot decide whether that is efficiency or a new source of paperwork. The hand count has been verified.

title: Ambipom
caption:
Ambipom
PSA 9

Ambipom doubled down on tail hands, which is one way to win an argument about productivity. I asked it to sort my cards and immediately regretted the invitation. Two thumbs up have become four.

title: Girafarig
caption:
Girafarig
PSA 10

Girafarig has a second face at the other end, so I am treating this as a two-person interview. Neither end agreed on the seating arrangement. The meeting minutes have been filed from both directions.

title: Stantler
caption:
Stantler
PSA 10

Stantler looks like it knows a shortcut through the forest and refuses to explain it. The antlers occupy more of the inspection area than my entire equipment budget. I am following at a respectful distance.

title: Smeargle
caption:
Smeargle
PSA 10

Smeargle brought its own paintbrush, which is a bold move in a room full of valuable cardboard. I have placed a tarp under the entire conversation. The art department is delighted; the grading department is tense.

title: Miltank
caption:
Miltank
PSA 10

Miltank seems prepared to remind everyone that a dairy operation is serious business. I will not make a milk joke in front of a Pokémon with that much confidence. The agricultural committee has approved this restraint.

title: Blissey
caption:
Blissey
PSA 8

Blissey looks like it would hand me an egg and then ask why I seem stressed. I do not have a good answer that fits on a grading form. The appointment has become a wellness check.

title: Chansey
caption:
Chansey
PSA 10

Chansey arrived with an egg and the bedside manner of a professional nurse. I told it the condition report was fine, but it insisted I sit down. The patient is apparently me.

title: Kangaskhan
caption:
Kangaskhan
PSA 8

Kangaskhan brought a child to the inspection and immediately made this a family appointment. I will be especially careful with my language and the placement of my snacks. The parenting division has taken over the room.

title: Tauros
caption:
Tauros
PSA 10

Tauros has three tails and the unmistakable energy of someone about to charge a filing cabinet. I moved the cabinet and then remembered the card is behind plastic. The precaution remains on the official record.

title: Pinsir
caption:
Pinsir
PSA 9

Pinsir looks like it uses the word handshake to mean a structural test. I am keeping my hands and my stapler well away from the pincers. The meeting will conclude without physical introductions.

title: Rhyhorn
caption:
Rhyhorn
PSA 9

Rhyhorn has the expression of a small train that has not yet learned about brakes. I planned a quick inspection and then reconsidered the layout of my furniture. The track is clear; the department is hiding.

title: Steelix
caption:
Steelix
PSA 10

Steelix is what happens when an already enormous rock snake discovers industrial materials. My desk is not rated for this much presence. I have upgraded the fictional inspection facility.

title: Cubone
caption:
Cubone
PSA 10

Cubone looks ready to tell a complicated story and I will listen without interrupting. The little helmet gives the card more emotional weight than I expected. The case notes are unusually gentle today.

title: Marowak
caption:
Marowak
PSA 10

Marowak carries a bone like a seasoned employee carries a tool it trusts. I declined to ask for a demonstration near my glass of water. The workplace safety officer approves.

title: Rhyperior
caption:
Rhyperior
PSA 10

Rhyperior looks like someone gave Rhydon a construction permit and unlimited materials. The arm cannons are not mentioned in our office insurance. The facilities audit will be held remotely.

title: Gastly
caption:
Gastly
PSA 10

Gastly is mostly face and atmospheric conditions, which makes measuring it unusually difficult. I tried to draw a boundary around the subject and the boundary became smoke. The ghost has escaped the chart.

title: Haunter
caption:
Haunter
PSA 10

Haunter looks like a pair of hands found a ghost and decided to keep it. I am not shaking either hand until the rest of the body explains itself. The interview remains open.

title: Duskull
caption:
Duskull
PSA 10

Duskull peers out from one eye as if it is reading my notes before I write them. I have closed the notebook out of professional self-defense. The spectral audit is complete.

title: Dusclops
caption:
Dusclops
PSA 7

Dusclops looks like a mummy hired to enforce the rules of a warehouse. I asked for the employee handbook and received a long, silent stare. The shift supervisor has been identified.

title: Trevenant & Dusknoir GX
caption:
Trevenant & Dusknoir GX
PSA 10

Dusknoir appears to have been promoted to manager of the entire afterlife. I am not asking about benefits until I am much older. The interview concluded before sundown.

title: Shuppet
caption:
Shuppet
PSA 10

Shuppet looks like a floating complaint that learned to smile at meetings. I have tried to address the underlying issue with a suggestion box. The box has disappeared.

title: Banette
caption:
Banette
PSA 10

Banette gives the impression that a toy learned everyone's secrets and took notes. I have checked that my old childhood plush is still where I left it. The inspection has become personal.

title: Spiritomb
caption:
Spiritomb
PSA 8

Spiritomb contains so many spirits that I cannot assign a single spokesperson. I requested a roll call and instantly regretted the administrative burden. The meeting is adjourned by unanimous haunting.

title: Rotom
caption:
Rotom
PSA 10

Rotom keeps getting into appliances, which explains several things about my printer. I asked it to fix the paper jam; it chose the lamp instead. The maintenance ticket remains unresolved.

title: Magnemite
caption:
Magnemite
PSA 6

Magnemite looks like it could attach itself to my filing cabinet and never leave. This pictured example is labeled PSA 6. The magnets make a strong case for keeping paper records farther away. I have moved the good pens.

title: Magneton
caption:
Magneton
PSA 10

Magneton is three Magnemite working together, which qualifies as a larger staff than mine. Their coordination makes my solo department feel underfunded. I have applied for two more magnets.

title: Magnezone
caption:
Magnezone
PSA 8

Magnezone has upgraded the magnet operation into a proper airborne command center. I admire the organizational growth and fear for my hard drive. The electronics are now across the room.

title: Porygon
caption:
Porygon
PSA 10

Porygon looks like a computer rendered a duck and then submitted it for approval. I am qualified to inspect the card, not to debug the duck. The software issue is considered a feature.

title: Dark Porygon2
caption:
Dark Porygon2
PSA 10

Porygon2 has smoothed out the edges and appears very pleased with the update. I wish my own software projects launched with this much confidence. Version two has passed the smile test.

title: Porygon-Z
caption:
Porygon-Z
PSA 9

Porygon-Z looks like version three installed a plug-in that nobody thoroughly reviewed. It has moved three times while I wrote one sentence. The release notes are urgently requested.

title: Beldum
caption:
Beldum
PSA 10

Beldum is a floating piece of steel with the social skills of an office stapler. I respect the focus, though I cannot tell whether it heard the question. The interview was brief and durable.

title: Metang
caption:
Metang
PSA 10

Metang seems to have assembled a team without conducting a single meeting. I have been attempting that myself for years. The operations department is impressed.

title: Metagross
caption:
Metagross
PSA 10

Metagross has four brains and therefore could probably finish these reports before breakfast. I considered offering it an internship, then remembered it would become my boss. The recruitment process has been canceled.

title: Bagon
caption:
Bagon
PSA 9

Bagon wants to fly so badly that every photograph looks like a motivational poster. I admire the ambition and have cleared the landing area just in case. The aviation dream is still on file.

title: Shelgon
caption:
Shelgon
PSA 9

Shelgon appears to be working on itself inside a very sturdy personal office. I asked when it would emerge and received no calendar invitation. The privacy request has been granted.

title: Salamence
caption:
Salamence
PSA 10

Salamence finally has wings and looks ready to expense every flight it ever imagined. I would sign the travel form, but the destination says sky. The reimbursement department is nervous.

title: Dratini
caption:
Dratini
PSA 10

Dratini is elegant enough to make my desk look like it needs a new tablecloth. I lowered my voice for the appointment without knowing why. The little dragon has excellent manners.

title: Goodra
caption:
Goodra
PSA 8

Goodra looks like it would hug everyone, possibly leaving the entire department slightly damp. I accept the gesture while protecting the paper records. The affection is officially appreciated.

title: Goomy
caption:
Goomy
PSA 10

Goomy is an extremely small blob that has somehow made a strong case for itself. I considered adding a moisture warning to the report. The tiny applicant has been approved.

title: Sliggoo
caption:
Sliggoo
PSA 10

Sliggoo is progressing through life at a speed my scheduling software does not support. I admire the patience and wish it would stop eyeing the folder. The paperwork remains mostly dry.

title: Axew
caption:
Axew
PSA 9

Axew has tiny tusks and a big ambition to be taken seriously. I relate more than I intended to this appointment. The rookie has earned a place on the roster.

title: Fraxure
caption:
Fraxure
PSA 10

Fraxure looks like it upgraded the tusks before updating the employee manual. The office furniture has been moved to give the new equipment space. The promotion is effective immediately.

title: Haxorus
caption:
Haxorus
PSA 10

Haxorus is a walking reminder that some meetings could have been avoided by seeing the axes first. I am being very respectful of the card's personal boundaries. The negotiation ended quickly.

title: Deino
caption:
Deino
PSA 9

Deino cannot see well but has no difficulty looking determined. I moved the chair out of its path, although the image was already taken. The accessibility plan is underway.

title: Zweilous
caption:
Zweilous
PSA 10

Zweilous has two heads and twice as many opinions about the inspection schedule. I opened separate case files and immediately ran out of folders. Both parties have been heard.

title: Hydreigon
caption:
Hydreigon
PSA 9

Hydreigon has three heads, which makes the comment section look manageable by comparison. I refuse to moderate a debate between them without hazard pay. The hearing is postponed indefinitely.

title: Sandile
caption:
Sandile
PSA 10

Sandile has the grin of a small crocodile who just discovered unattended snacks. I have secured the lunch area and returned to the card. The snack audit is complete.

title: Krokorok
caption:
Krokorok
PSA 10

Krokorok wears the expression of a desert outlaw who knows exactly where my keys are. I am staying polite while checking my pockets. The suspect remains remarkably photogenic.

title: Krookodile
caption:
Krookodile
PSA 10

Krookodile has sunglasses built into its face and the confidence to use them indoors. I cannot match that level of cool with a desk lamp and a ruler. The style department has won the meeting.

title: Scraggy
caption:
Scraggy
PSA 10

Scraggy seems to be holding up its own pants while trying to look tough. I admire the commitment to an image in difficult logistical circumstances. The wardrobe department has offered a belt.

title: Hawlucha
caption:
Hawlucha
PSA 10

Hawlucha looks ready to leap off the card and enter a wrestling ring. I have asked the audience to keep the aisle clear for a dramatic entrance. The match has been postponed for grading.

title: Noivern
caption:
Noivern
PSA 10

Noivern appears to have heard the smallest rustle of my grading notes from across the room. I lowered the volume on my keyboard out of respect. The sound check passed.

title: Noibat
caption:
Noibat
PSA 10

Noibat is mostly ears, which means I cannot quietly revise my earlier assessment. I have spoken clearly and apologized to the stapler. The tiny bat has acknowledged the correction.

title: Tinkatuff
caption:
Tinkatuff
PSA 10

Tinkatuff upgraded the hammer and seems to have added a management title. The safety briefing did not include an option to disagree. I am wearing the imaginary helmet.

title: Tinkaton
caption:
Tinkaton
PSA 10

Tinkaton brought a massive hammer to a conversation about delicate cardboard. The tool is impressive; the room is no longer suitable for an inspection. I have moved the meeting to a reinforced table.

title: Dachsbun
caption:
Dachsbun
PSA 10

Dachsbun has finished baking and now acts like it owns the whole bakery. The smell is imaginary but my hunger is fully documented. The pastry department has approved the candidate.

title: Sprigatito
caption:
Sprigatito
PSA 10

Sprigatito is cute enough to make me forget my process and feline enough to judge me for it. I have hidden the loose sleeves before they become toys. The cat remains unimpressed.

title: Floragato
caption:
Floragato
PSA 10

Floragato looks like the middle evolution got a dramatic stage role and learned to use props. I will not ask it to demonstrate near the card binder. The performance review is enthusiastic.

title: Meowscarada
caption:
Meowscarada
PSA 10

Meowscarada appears ready to turn a grading appointment into a magic show. I counted the cards before and after the trick. The numbers match, but I remain suspicious.

title: Fuecoco
caption:
Fuecoco
PSA 10

Fuecoco is smiling like it found the snack table and forgot why it came. I have gently redirected the little crocodile toward the inspection. The refreshments are now supervised.
